bounds: One opaque selected-file capability, mail/chat purposes, symbolic sizes 6 and 21 MiB, revisions 0/1, one read and one terminal publication.
limitations: The native byte reader receives a stream already authorized by the host, not a renderer path or URI. Browser revision and selection fencing is checked by the actual Files implementation. Native grant, account/conversation fencing and user-visible picker acceptance remain host/device checks.

Weak fairness of a read settlement assumes I/O returns or fails. The model does not claim a provider responds or an upload succeeds. Native permission revocation during stream I/O and process crash recovery are not modeled. Shared chat MIME, compression, aggregate and nonimage payload limits still apply after materialization.

assumptions: Weak fairness of I/O settlement or cancellation.
